releases.author: gwmage
releases.description:
Setup used to dead-end for anyone who did not already have a Rootr account: the settings screen asked for an API key and a workspace ID with no link to get either.

- New **Create one free** button at the top of settings, linking to the setup page.
- New **Check connection** button — validates your key and workspace ID and reports the workspace name, so a failed push is no longer the first sign something is wrong.
- **Rootr base URL** moved to an Advanced section at the bottom; it has a working default.
- README now leads with what the plugin does.

No change to what is synced or to the privacy scope.

releases.author: gwmage
releases.description:
First release.

One-way sync: push a chosen vault folder (or tagged notes) into a Rootr team workspace, so teammates and Claude/ChatGPT can read and write them.

- Vault stays the source of truth — nothing is written back into your vault
- Only the folder/tag you configure is read; nothing else is scanned
- No telemetry, no background transfer, no polling
- Conflict-safe: a note changed in Rootr since the last push is never silently overwritten
